full_page.content:
Page 233 Cont.
Sep. 11 Mary Mecameracki - 34 - of Hamtram. - infantile paralysis since 8 - for six yrs. could not walk a step. Then was told a second time while sitting in back yard; "Walk. Take sticks and walk." At first it was extremely difficult. Now has crutches and can get along ... works two weeks a month only bread-winner.
Page 234
Sep. 12 Mrs. Anna Selinsky - middle aged looking for work in kitchen etc - day work.
13 Mary Ghyscls - 6 - peculiar - most unusual weakness in not able to speak now over two years.
Mrs. T. Bondie - 35 - of Willis, Mich. Route 1 - lost wife on Saturday, leaving 5 children - youngest three - asks for prayers that he may suc- ceed in finding some one to help him raise the children in the rever- ence and love of God.
Anton Maslan - 53 - Arthritis and seemly enemic for two years. Drs. baffled after 16 xrays. Goes to Holy Com. 3 times a year. Promises weekly Com. if better by end of week.
Thanks - - Frank Gladish - 61 - baptist - in oxigen a week ago last night when poor wife came to monastery and Enrolled him perpetually - better before morning - Sleeping well ....
Miss Maude Cocklin - methodist - 37 - seven yrs almost deaf. Gert Witham - 45 - nerveous break or a nun John Bolane - 54 - losing his sight
Page 235 Sep. 17 Anthony Kouri - 58 - has family of 8 and very little work. Martin-Child - water on brain - very little better.
Robert Horton - 19 - extremely nervous. Good lad but ?...
19 Mary Burkett - 55 - non C. of Newark, 0. - poor health - nerveous, etc. Her sister here asks for prayers. Same sister
Mary Phillips - 20 - working hard is promoted - now fears she may fall short of expectations.
